Continue.description: Indicates to continue a previously failed build attempt

Help.description: Shows the help text for this build assembly

Skip.description: List of targets to be skipped. Empty list skips all dependencies

Target.description: List of targets to be invoked. Default is '{default_target}'

Verbosity.description: Logging verbosity during build execution. Default is 'Normal'

BuildProjectFile.description: Path to the build project (.csproj) relative to the repository root. Defaults to 'build/_build.csproj' when unset. Read by the Fallout global tool's in-tool runner.

BuildNodes.description: MSBuild nodes for Restore and Compile; 0 uses one node for each processor - Default is 0

CiOs.description: CIPlan: the os input of a manual run (auto, linux, full, or a comma-separated list of windows and macos)

deployment.description: Deployment offering for PublishRelease and PackRelease: native-aot, self-contained, framework-dependent or dotnet-tool

ExecutableType.description: Executable type for E2E tests: aot, trimmed, untrimmed, tool or all (those four); native-aot, self-contained, framework-dependent or dotnet-tool (a packaged release profile); or offerings (all four packaged)

ExtensionProcessesDir.description: Output directory for self-contained extension process folders and archives

MorphirupBuildImage.description: Linux only: publish morphirup inside this image, with this machine's .NET SDK mounted, so the executable needs that image's glibc and no newer

MorphirupContainers.description: Linux only: container images with glibc and neither .NET nor libicu, in which CheckMorphirup also runs the executable

MorphirupPlatforms.description: The platforms whose morphirup assets MorphirupChecksums requires (default: every platform releases build)

PluginVersion.description: Version for the proto plugin release (e.g., 0.1.0)

ProtoPluginDir.description: Output directory for proto plugin WASM

ReleaseAssetsDir.description: Folder for the morphirup release assets and their checksum file

ReleaseDir.description: Output directory for release profile artifacts

ReleaseVersion.description: Version string for the new release (e.g., 0.3.0 or 0.3.0-beta.1)

SingleFileUntrimmedDir.description: Output directory for untrimmed single-file executables

TestHangTimeout.description: Time with no test progress after which a Microsoft.Testing.Platform test run takes a hang dump and stops - Default is '10m'

TestParallelism.description: Test: the number of test assemblies that run at the same time - Default is half the processors, rounded up, from 1 to 4

TestScope.description: Test: 'all' runs every test; 'platform' runs only the tests with the PlatformSpecific marker - Default is 'all'
